hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.zig) zig fmt "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in */zig-out/*|*/zig-cache/*|*/.zig-cache/*|*/vendor/*) echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit build artifacts or vendored code' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac

PreToolUse.description: Block edits to build artifacts and vendored code
